title: BlackRock Wants This: Cardano’s New Programmable Tokens
description:
The conversation delves into recent advancements in Cardano's blockchain technology, particularly the introduction of programmable tokens via SIP 113. Peter discusses the implications of this development for institutional investors, compliance requirements, and the potential for broader adoption of digital assets. The conversation also highlights insights from Larry Fink, CEO of BlackRock, regarding the necessity of tokenisation and compliance in the financial sector. Furthermore, Peter outlines various compliance solutions being developed within the Cardano ecosystem to facilitate institutional integration and enhance the platform's overall functionality.

Takeaways
✅ Cardano's programmable tokens mark a significant advancement.
✅ CIP 113 allows for compliance logic to be enforced on tokens.
✅ Larry Fink emphasises the need for tokenisation in finance.
✅ Programmable money must meet compliance standards.
✅ Cardano's native asset model treats tokens as first-class citizens.
✅ CIP-113 enhances the programmability of Cardano's assets.
✅ Institutional adoption requires robust compliance solutions.
✅ Veridian and Midnight Network are key compliance tools.
✅ The Cardano Foundation is focused on enterprise enablement.
✅ Future adoption of digital assets in Cardano looks promising.
